title: teucrium oxylepis subsp. marianum
intro: Teucrium oxylepis subsp. marianum, commonly known as a member of the Teucrium genus, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family, known for its medicinal properties. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Teucrium oxylepis subsp. marianum include acting as an expectorant and a carminative, which helps in relieving cough and digestive issues, respectively. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its health benefits.
